tasks.short: Design and execute solvent recovery experiments

steps.what: Open the solvent and product recovery brief
Design laboratory and field settings for the experiment

tasks.design: The solvent and product recovery brief is opened from {DOCS}. The manager designs the laboratory or field settings and executes the experiments. A setting that was not designed is not treated as run.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field and laboratory notes were kept apart from the brief.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief is stored, so the design starts from the same solvent and product.
tasks.still_hard: The design and the execution stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager designs and executes the experiment.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the brief before designing the settings.

evidence.claim: A brief can be opened, and the experiment stays with the manager. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a solvent or product recovery experiment is needed and ends when the manager has executed it or noted the settings not run.
The brief has experiment id, solvent, and product, written by the manager. Results are written after the run.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the field setting can host this solvent.
research_questions: Which designed settings were not executed?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a brief that already exists. Design and execution stay with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop methods to recover ethanol from bioreactor streams

steps.what: Open bioreactor liquid and gas stream readings
Compute ethanol and other fuels the streams recover
Develop methods for complex streams still unrecovered

tasks.design: Liquid and gas readings from the bioreactor are opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. Recovered ethanol and other fuels are the stored outlet divided by the stored inlet. The manager develops the method for complex streams the figure does not cover. A missing reading leaves the figure blank. The plant is not started by the figure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stream readings were copied off the panel into a side sheet before a method was discussed.
tasks.enabler_now: The readings are stored on the batch, so the ratio does not need a side sheet.
tasks.still_hard: A complex stream, and the method to recover fuel from it, stay with the manager at the plant.
tasks.human_edge: The manager develops the recovery method.

ambition.what: A batch with inlet and outlet readings shows a recovery figure the day they are stored, and the manager still develops the method.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the readings beside the figure.

reach.learn: Which stream the method still has to cover.

evidence.claim: A recovery figure is a ratio of stored stream readings, and the manager develops the method. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a bioreactor batch has stream readings and ends when the manager has written the method for what the figure does not cover.
A reading has batch id, stream id, and amount, entered from the plant. A missing amount leaves the figure blank.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether every gas and liquid stream on this bioreactor is metered.
research_questions: Which batches are blank because a reading is missing?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts batches whose inlet and outlet readings are stored. Developing the method for a complex stream stays with the manager, and the plant is not run by the figure.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Solvent experiments stay with the manager. Ethanol recovery figures use stored stream readings, and the method for a complex stream stays with the manager.
reach: The bench sees which setting was not executed.
The plant sees which stream reading was blank.
skills_to_grow: Do not invent a recovery result.
Do not start the plant from a figure.
role.ambitious_version: A batch with inlet and outlet readings shows a recovery figure the day they are stored, and the manager still writes the method.
